initiatives.name: La Plata SURJ
initiatives.description: The La Plata County chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice (SURJ), based in Durango, CO. It organizes white people for racial justice and is accountable to Southwest Movement for Black Lives.

initiatives.name: Durango Peace and Justice
initiatives.description: Durango-based coalition, founded in 2016, that shares resources and event announcements for peace and social justice groups and campaigns in Durango and La Plata County.

initiatives.name: Transformative Freedom Fund
initiatives.description: Supporting the authentic selves of transgender Coloradans by removing financial barriers to transition related healthcare.
